symptom: ako/mxcli#1650 (upstream mendixlabs/mxcli#1641): a view entity using STRING_AGG(s.Name, '; ') next to GROUP BY was MDL036 "not aggregated and is not a GROUP BY expression" — refused by check, by exec, and by exec --no-check ("invalid OQL in view entity"), while the same view with COUNT passed
cause: The GROUP BY rules (MDL034/035/036) and MDL037 recognised an aggregate by a hand-written regex, count|sum|avg|min|max. mxbuild's OQL grammar has a sixth aggregate token, STRING_AGG. --no-check did not help because execCreateViewEntity runs ValidateOQLSyntax itself as a write barrier, and MDL036 lives there
file: mdl/executor/oql_view_select_checks.go (oqlAggregateFunctions), oql_type_inference.go (stringAggType, validateViewEntityTypes), version_gates.go (oqlUsesStringAgg), sdk/versions/registry.go (entryAt), sdk/versions/mendix-10.yaml + mendix-11.yaml
insight: Read the platform's own list instead of guessing: `strings -a -el Mendix.Modeler.Core.dll` shows the OQL lexer's literal tokens ('SUM' 'COUNT' 'AVG' 'MIN' 'MAX' 'STRING_AGG'), and the same grep over every cached mxbuild — then streaming `tar -xz --wildcards '*Mendix.Modeler.Core.dll'` out of CDN tarballs — bisected the floor without a single full download: 11.2.0 (11.0/11.1 lack it) and, separately, 10.24.22 on the 10.24 line. mx check confirmed both ends (CE0174 "Unknown function 'string_agg'" below). The trap was the column TYPE: it changed in 11.7.0 — the argument's own type on 11.2–11.6.12 (String(100) over a String(100), exactly), a derived String(200) from 11.7 and on 10.24.22+ — so a version-blind type rule is a false refusal on one side or the other; it is judged only where the project version is known. Measure a grid (String(100)/String(500)/unlimited sources × declarations) on BOTH sides of a boundary before encoding a type. A feature on two release lines needs two registry entries (min/max on the older line), and every registry view has to pick the entry covering the version — 'lowest min_version' listed it unavailable on every 11.x. Do not 'fix' --no-check by taking MDL036 off the handler's barrier: MDL036 covers two shapes, and only one is runtime-only — `datepart(MONTH, e.D)` next to `group by datepart(YEAR, e.D)` builds at 0 errors (mx check 11.13.0), but `length(s.Name)` next to `group by b.Code` is CE0174 "Every expression in the SELECT clause must be included in the GROUP BY clause", despite MDL036's "MxBuild accepts the view" message.
